name: Documentation set
description: Plan a documentation set, write it, and verify every claim in it against the code.

steps.objective: Read the project end to end and decide what the documentation set must contain: the audiences, the page list, and the single job each page does.
Write the pages that explain what this is and why it is shaped this way, for a reader who has not used it.
Write the task-shaped pages: installing, the first run, the daily loop, reviews and gates, and recovering when something goes wrong.
Write the lookup pages: every command and flag, every configuration key, the sensors, the personas, and the shipped workflows.
Write the pages for someone changing pi rather than using it: authoring a workflow, overriding a persona, adding a sensor, porting to another harness.
Check the written documentation against the code. Run the commands it shows, confirm the defaults it states, and list every claim that is wrong, stale, or unverifiable.
